newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close sharply lower amid rate anxiety.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close sharply lower amid rate anxiety.

text.p: Leading blue chips stumbled on Monday from record levels set last week amid concerns about monetary policy on both sides of the Atlantic, traders said. The FTSE 100 closed 44.4 points lower at 3,919.7, after climbing to a record at 3,994.1 on Friday.
Dividend payouts trimmed 8.17 points from the leading blue chip index. But losses were broadbased, with decliners beating advancers by a margin of nine to one.
It was the biggest one-day drop since July 16, when a Wall Street-inspired selloff knocked off 66 points from the FTSE 100. Volume was light, with only 436.0 million shares recorded.
